1. User manual of one licence/registration one login for FBO:-

**Note: Log in id changed automatically by system after your licence/registration generated by authority successfully and sent by email and sms to you.**

**Step 0:** First Open the web browser and search for FoSCoS Web portal and login to FBO by just enter particular licence number and registration number.

[Screenshot of a web browser displaying the FoSCoS (Food Safety Compliance System) portal. The page shows two main sign-in boxes: 'User Sign-in' (for Licence & Registration Purpose) with fields for 'Application Ref. No./Licence No./Certificate No.' and 'Enter Captcha', and 'Small (Petty) FBO Sign-In!' (for Registration Purpose only) with fields for 'Email-Id or Mobile Number' and 'Enter Captcha'.]

**Step 1:** Go for registration and licence number/ref number and fill password and captcha for sign in.

[Screenshot of a web browser displaying the FoSCoS (Food Safety Compliance System) portal. The page shows two main sign-in boxes: 'User Sign-in' (for Licence & Registration Purpose) with fields for 'Password' and 'Enter Captcha', and 'Small (Petty) FBO Sign-In!' (for Registration Purpose only) with fields for 'Email-Id or Mobile Number' and 'Enter Captcha'.]

<!-- page 2 -->

**Step 2: Log in successful with same registration and licence number/ref number.**

[Image of a web browser window displaying the "FoSCoS" (Food Safety & Compliance System) dashboard. The browser address bar shows "fotraining.fssai.gov.in/public/fbo/dashboard". The page header contains the FSSAI logo and the FoSCoS logo. The main content area is titled "Dashboard" with a "Pending Action" link. Below are four colored boxes: "Incomplete Application" (blue), "Submitted Applications with Successful Payment" (red), "Reverted Application by Authority" (teal), and "Issued" (green). Below these boxes is a section titled "Incomplete Applications - Registration Certificate". The left sidebar menu lists: Dashboard, License/Registration, Renewal, Modification, Surrender / Transfer, Food Consumer Grievance, Inspection, Audit Management, Hygiene Management, Help, Improvement Notice, Adjudication. The Windows taskbar is visible at the bottom.]
